name: The New Alfred Hitchcock Presents
description: The New Alfred Hitchcock Presents is an American anthology series that aired on NBC from 1985 to 1986, and on the USA Network from 1987 to 1989. The series is an updated re-imagining of the classic 1955 series Alfred Hitchcock Presents.

videos.title: Incident in a Small Jail
videos.overview: When a man stops in a small town to get gas for his car, he runs into trouble.

videos.title: Man from the South
videos.overview: A man proposes a weird deal: To win a sports car, a down and out gambler must light his lighter 10 times in a row, or lose his finger.

videos.title: Bang! You're Dead!
videos.overview: A little girl wants to play army with the boys, but they tell her she needs to have a gun before she can join them.

videos.title: An Unlocked Window
videos.overview: A nurse decides to stay in a house on a stormy night. The nurse thinks that she is safe in the house but it turns out that there is a killer in the vicinity.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: A professor spurns the legal system to seek revenge on the man who raped his wife.

videos.title: Night Fever
videos.overview: A gun man injured from a robbery in which he killed a cop, tries to charm a nurse into helping him escape from hospital custody.

videos.title: Wake Me When I'm Dead
videos.overview: Trial of a woman who killed her husband while hypnotically transported to a past life.

videos.title: Final Escape
videos.overview: A woman serving a life sentence for murder hits upon an airtight escape plan.

videos.title: The Night Caller
videos.overview: A divorce is driven to drastic retaliatory measures after being the victim of a series of phone calls and constant survillance from a near by appartant.

videos.title: Method Actor
videos.overview: Paul Dano is a film star and has been nominated many times, but never won the big one. When a role comes along that spells Oscar, he loses out to Lone Richards, a young hunk Dano calls ""a face for a nine inch TV screen."" Richards naively seeks Dano's advice on how to play the part. Bad move. Dano gives Richards bad advice on purpose and Richards loses the part and Dano gets it. Richards becomes enraged by this and wants revenge.

videos.title: The Human Interest Story
videos.overview: A TV reporter looks for the human interest story behind the short-lived takeover of the station's airwaves by a former technician who claims to be an alien with an urgent warning to Earthlings.

videos.title: Breakdown
videos.overview: After closing a major drug deal, a ruthless businessman is paralyzed in an auto accident, and presumed dead by all who see him- including the coroner.

videos.title: Prisoners
videos.overview: Ironically, it's an escaped convict who brings a sense of liberation to a housewife: she insists on going with him as his "hostage".

videos.title: Gigolo
videos.overview: A gold digging groom makes short work of his middle-aged wife, but his attempts to round up her jewels are met with opposition from her "children" - an army of cats.

videos.title: The Gloating Place
videos.overview: A withdrawn teenager is fascinated with the instant celebrity of a murdered classmate and fakes an assault on herself.

videos.title: The Right Kind of Medicine
videos.overview: A bank robber is wounded in a shoot-out, then forced to endure an excruciating wait for a painkiller at the pharmacy.

videos.title: Beast In View
videos.overview: A psychiatrist is terrorized by menacing phone calls and the killing of her dog following her marriage to one of her patients.

videos.title: A Very Happy Ending
videos.overview: A poor little rich boy who's deaf witnesses a murder, then blackmails the hit man into doing a job for him.

videos.title: The Canary Sedan
videos.overview: A woman goes to Hong Kong to be with her husband.

videos.title: Enough Rope For Two
videos.overview: A camping trip for two becomes a flight from murder full of twists and double-crosses when a Harvard-bound law student goes against his better judgement and lets his girl friend bring her "cousin" along.

videos.title: The Creeper
videos.overview: A fashion designer is terrified that she may be the next target of the creeper who may have the keys to her appartment.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: The arrest of a newspaper reporter on his birthday for a murder supposedly committed 22 years ago comes as a complete surprise to the accused.

videos.title: The Jar
videos.overview: An artist's years of failure are behind after he finds a jar which holds mysterious contents and entrances to those who view it.

videos.title: Deadly Honeymoon
videos.overview: Following a whirlwind courtship, a new bride fears her luck's run out when she learns that her doctor husband has heavy gambling debts and two deceased formor wives who were heavily insured.

videos.title: Four O'Clock
videos.overview: Time is running out for a judge who's surprised, bound and gagged by burglars in his house after rigging a bomb to eliminate his wife and her suspected lover.

videos.title: Road Hog

videos.title: The Initiation

videos.title: When This Man Dies
